tasks.subject: Task 1: DownlinkJitterEstimator
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Pure per-speaker estimator producing adaptive prebuffer `targetSamples` + `lateBurst` from relative arrival delay, with JVM tests.

**Files:**
- Create: `app/src/main/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/voice/DownlinkJitterEstimator.kt`
- Test: `app/src/test/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/voice/DownlinkJitterEstimatorTest.kt`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `onPacket(rtpSamples, arrivalNanos, wasLate)` updates 200ms peak-hold buckets (40=8s), recomputes @Volatile target/p95/lateBurst.
- [ ] `target=clamp(p95(live peaks),FLOOR,MAX)`, peak=`maxD-min(liveMinD)`; cold->FLOOR_SAMPLES 480.
- [ ] p95 index `ceil(0.95*n)-1` over live buckets only; empty never counted as 0.
- [ ] `lateBurst` = >=3 LATE in 200ms.
- [ ] No hot-path alloc; `rtpNanos=(rtpSamples/480)*10_000_000L`.
- [ ] Tests pass on JVM.

**Verify:** `export JAVA_HOME="/Applications/Android Studio.app/Contents/jbr/Contents/Home" && ./gradlew testDebugUnitTest --tests "me.danielstiner.dumble.mumble.voice.DownlinkJitterEstimatorTest"` -> PASS.

**Steps:** TDD estimator test (cold/steady/grow/spike/clamp/drift/late-burst) -> DownlinkJitterEstimator.kt -> run -> commit. Full code in plan doc (Task 1).

tasks.subject: Task 2: SpeakerStream adaptive anchor + valve
tasks.description:
**Goal:** `SpeakerStream` owns the estimator; `offer` gains `arrivalNanos` + feeds it; anchor gate reads a `targetSamples()` supplier; add `plcDeepen()` valve that deepens on a late-burst WITHOUT touching `consecutivePlc`.

**Files:**
- Modify: `app/src/main/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/voice/SpeakerStream.kt`
- Test: `app/src/test/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/voice/SpeakerStreamTest.kt`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Ctor `estimator = DownlinkJitterEstimator()` + `targetSamples: () -> Int = { estimator.targetSamples }` replaces old `prebufferSamples`.
- [ ] `offer(ts,opus,span,term,arrivalNanos)` feeds `estimator.onPacket(ts,arrivalNanos,result==LATE)` for non-EMPTY, returns result.
- [ ] Anchor gate uses `targetSamples()`.
- [ ] `fillTick` fires `plcDeepen()` when anchored AND lateBurst AND buffered<targetSamples() AND ticksSinceDeepen>=10; plcDeepen pushes PLC + holds cursor, NO consecutivePlc++.
- [ ] Part A underrun path unchanged.
- [ ] Part A tests migrated (`prebufferSamples=N`->`targetSamples={N}`, +arrivalNanos) + pass; new valve test asserts no spurious resetToIdle (cursor>=0).
- [ ] assembleDebug + suite green.

**Verify:** `export JAVA_HOME="/Applications/Android Studio.app/Contents/jbr/Contents/Home" && ./gradlew assembleDebug testDebugUnitTest` -> BUILD SUCCESSFUL, tests pass.

**Steps:** ctor+supplier -> offer+feed -> anchor gate -> valve+plcDeepen (no consecutivePlc++) + DEEPEN_INTERVAL_TICKS -> migrate Part A tests -> valve test -> build+test -> commit. Full code in plan doc (Task 2). CRITICAL: plcDeepen must not touch consecutivePlc.

tasks.subject: Task 3: Engine plumb + JitterStats flow
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Pass `arrivalNanos` into `stream.offer` and emit an aggregate `JitterStats` flow from the playback tick.

**Files:**
- Create: `app/src/main/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/voice/JitterStats.kt`
- Modify: `app/src/main/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/voice/AudioVoiceEngine.kt`
- Modify: `app/src/main/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/voice/SpeakerStream.kt`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `JitterStats(targetMs=10, p95Ms=0)` data class.
- [ ] `SpeakerStream.jitterTargetMs()` (=estimator.targetSamples/48) + `jitterP95Ms()`.
- [ ] `onIncomingFrame` calls `stream.offer(tsSamples, copy, span, terminator, arrivalNanos)`.
- [ ] engine `val jitter: StateFlow<JitterStats>` updated each playback tick to MAX target/p95 across speakers.
- [ ] assembleDebug + suite green.

**Verify:** `export JAVA_HOME="/Applications/Android Studio.app/Contents/jbr/Contents/Home" && ./gradlew assembleDebug testDebugUnitTest` -> BUILD SUCCESSFUL, tests pass.

**Steps:** JitterStats.kt -> SpeakerStream accessors -> engine `_jitter`/`jitter` after `_latency` -> offer(+arrivalNanos) -> emit after `_latency.value` in playbackLoop -> build+test -> commit. Full code in plan doc (Task 3).

tasks.subject: Task 4: Diagnostics Jitter readout
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Mirror `JitterStats` onto `MumbleManager` and render a "Jitter" line (Target / p95) on the Audio diagnostics screen.

**Files:**

- Modify: `app/src/main/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/ui/DumbleApp.kt`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `MumbleManager` exposes `val jitterStats: StateFlow<JitterStats>`, fed by `engine.jitter` in start(), reset in shutdown().
- [ ] `AudioDiagnosticsScreen` takes `jitter: JitterStats` + renders a "Jitter" section (Target/p95) after Latency.
- [ ] `DumbleApp` collects `jitterStats` + passes it.
- [ ] assembleDebug + suite green.

**Verify:** `export JAVA_HOME="/Applications/Android Studio.app/Contents/jbr/Contents/Home" && ./gradlew assembleDebug testDebugUnitTest` -> BUILD SUCCESSFUL, tests pass.

**Steps:** MumbleManager `_jitterStats`/`jitterStats` + collector + shutdown reset -> AudioDiagnosticsScreen jitter param + Jitter section -> DumbleApp collect + pass -> build+test -> commit. Full code in plan doc (Task 4).
